name: Ape Skate Shootout
summary:
Shoot. Skate. Toot. 

Come hang out at the Skate Park, where you can slide down half pipes and pull off sweet tricks while hanging out with your friends - and grab a gun to mow them down. 

In Ape Skate Shootout you can : 
- Complete skateboard tricks and stunts to earn SkateCash, used to upgrade your character or the Skate Park itself
- Charge your farts observing your gas meter, and use them to boost around the Skate Park (or to disrespect your fallen foes). 
- Find a variety of weapons to mow down other
